仅配置导入会覆盖同编号配置并新增文件中的配置和资源，保留玩家、余额、账单及其他配: Configuration imports overwrite matching configuration and add configuration and resources from the file, retaining players, balances, bills and other configuration.

充值金额不足以支付当前账单: The top-up would leave insufficient balance for the current bill.
